slides.heading: Reception — Spring 1, Week 1
slides.sub: New sounds taught directly, practised and applied in words, captions and the matching decodable book.

slides.heading: Mon
slides.objective: Learn the new sound "x" (/ks/) and start reading and spelling words that use it.

slides.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="320" height="320" role="img" aria-label="box" class="wp-icon wp-raster" data-picture="box"><image href="data:image/png;base64," x="0" y="0" width="100" height="100" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"/></svg>

slides.mnemonic: Xander the fox crosses his front paws, ks-ks, when he's about to pounce.

character.name: Xander
character.blurb: Xander is a cheeky little creature who always crosses his paws over each other before he moves.

slides.pronunciation_note: This is two sounds squashed together, 'k' then 's' — say them fast, one after the other: ks.
slides.formation_cue: Start at the top left of the small letters and slant down to the right. Finish on the line. Lift, start at the top right and slant down to the left, crossing the first line. Finish on the line.
slides.formation_rhyme: One line down, cross it over.
slides.action: Cross your arms in front of your chest like an X while saying ks-ks.
slides.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="320" height="320" role="img" aria-label="box" class="wp-icon wp-raster" data-picture="box"><image href="data:image/png;base64," x="0" y="0" width="100" height="100" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"/></svg>

slides.tip: The 'e' says its long name 'ee' instead of a short sound — point at a boy in a picture and say 'he is...' to link the word to its meaning.

slides.heading: Tue
slides.objective: Learn the new sound "y" (/j/) and start reading and spelling words that use it.

slides.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="320" height="320" role="img" aria-label="yo-yo" class="wp-icon wp-raster" data-picture="yoyo"><image href="data:image/png;base64," x="0" y="0" width="100" height="100" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"/></svg>

slides.mnemonic: Yolanda the young duckling yawns and yelps, y-y-y, first thing every morning by the pond.

character.name: Yolanda
character.blurb: Yolanda is the youngest duckling in her family and always the first one awake, calling out to everyone else.

slides.pronunciation_note: A quick sound made at the front of the mouth, 'y-y-y' — don't turn it into 'yuh'.
slides.formation_cue: Start at the top left of the small letters and slant down to the right, to the line. Lift, start at the top right and slant down to the left, through the first line and on below it. Finish below the line.
slides.formation_rhyme: Two lines meet, one dips below.
slides.action: Cup your hands round your mouth like a little beak and call out y-y-y.
slides.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="320" height="320" role="img" aria-label="yo-yo" class="wp-icon wp-raster" data-picture="yoyo"><image href="data:image/png;base64," x="0" y="0" width="100" height="100" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"/></svg>

slides.heading: Wed
slides.objective: Learn the new sound "z" (/z/) and start reading and spelling words that use it.

slides.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="320" height="320" role="img" aria-label="zip" class="wp-icon wp-raster" data-picture="zip"><image href="data:image/png;base64," x="0" y="0" width="100" height="100" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"/></svg>

slides.mnemonic: Zinnia the bee zigzags between the flowers, zzz, never flying in a straight line.

character.name: Zinnia
character.blurb: Zinnia is a busy little bee who always flies in quick zigzags instead of a straight path.

slides.pronunciation_note: A buzzing sound you can hold, 'zzzz' — feel it tickle your lips, don't add 'uh' on the end.
slides.formation_cue: Start at the top left of the small letters. Go straight across to the right, slant down to the bottom left, then straight across to the right. Finish at the bottom right.
slides.action: Trace a zigzag in the air with one finger while buzzing zzz.
slides.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="320" height="320" role="img" aria-label="zip" class="wp-icon wp-raster" data-picture="zip"><image href="data:image/png;base64," x="0" y="0" width="100" height="100" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"/></svg>

slides.heading: Thu
slides.objective: Extra practice blending and segmenting everything taught this week — no new content today.

slides.dictation: A fox hid in a den.

slides.heading: Fri
slides.objective: Revisit everything taught this week, read the matched decodable book, and check how securely it has been learned.

slides.dictation: A hen and a fox ran.
